notes: ZOMBIES ONLINE now works like multiplayer: QUICK PLAY drops you straight into a co-op game that is already running, or starts one that other players can drop into. No waiting for a host.
The Zombies online lobby has the same match service status, version line and ON YOUR WI-FI games as multiplayer, plus PRIVATE CODE matches with a pre-game lobby where the host presses START.
FRIENDS AND PARTY in Zombies: the same party panel as multiplayer - your friend code, add friends, JOIN a friend's party, leaderboard and party chat.
PARTY JOINING: when the party leader presses QUICK PLAY in Zombies (or joins a private code), the whole party follows them into the same game. Party members see WAITING FOR LEADER until then.
